summary: Frontend-only verification of per-step Ekstraları ekle panel + live summary breakdown, home bundle strip and separate price cards tabs. All acceptance criteria PASSED. Wizard Step 1 (people) shows extras-quick-add with 6 insurance rows (quick-insurance-{ins_8d,ins_15d,ins_30d,ins_30d_plus,ins_60d,ins_60d_plus}) and 4 eSIM rows (esim_1gb/3gb/10gb/unlimited). Selecting ins_15d + esim_3gb +1 on Step 1 keeps summary at 'Fiyat için vize türü seçin.'. Advancing to Step 2, state is preserved (ins_15d highlighted, esim_3gb qty=1). Picking '30 Günlük Tek Girişli Dubai Vizesi – 5.190 ₺' and dates 01.03.2026→10.03.2026 makes aside 'Başvuru özeti' render full breakdown: Vize 5.190₺ + Sigorta 15gün Temel x1 560₺ + eSIM 3GB x1 740₺ − Paket indirimi %10 (-130₺) = Toplam 6.360₺. eSIM +1 recomputes to 7.026₺ (5190+560+1480-204). Reducing eSIM qty to 0 removes the eSIM line AND the paket indirimi row (no ghost), total drops to 5.750₺. Insurance rows filtered by visa duration: with 30-day visa selected only ins_8d/15d/30d/30d_plus listed (ins_60d and ins_60d_plus hidden). Home page: home-bundle-strip renders 3 cards (pack_standard 6.360₺, pack_comfort 8.955,60₺, pack_long 11.828,50₺) each with 'Bu paketle başvur' → /basvuru. separate-price-cards tabs price-tab-visa / price-tab-insurance / price-tab-esim work; visa tab lists visa types with TL prices and Seç buttons; insurance tab lists 6 ins_* cards; eSIM tab lists 4 esim_* cards. Mobile 390x844: aside stacks below content on /basvuru, extras-quick-add-toggle collapses and re-expands, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390).
critical_code_review_comments: Apply.jsx has grown to 2145 lines. Consider splitting each wizard step into its own component (StepPeople, StepVisa, StepDocs, StepSummary) plus a shared useApplyState hook.

ExtrasQuickAdd hides insurance rows when their validity exceeds visa duration but leaves esim rows unfiltered. If a >30-day eSIM is picked with a 30-day visa the summary still applies %10 bundle. Consider filtering esim products the same way or showing a warning.

Home price-cards visa tab only filters applicant_type==='adult' — visa uzatma / transit visas are shown here too because they are 'adult'. This is expected but a small subtitle differentiating 'ilk başvuru vs uzatma' would help.
test_credentials: Not required - all tested surfaces are public.
seed_data_creation: Wizard was driven up to Step 2 with TEST data but no application was submitted (no POST /api/applications). No DB rows created this run.
